description.en: The information about the users to be added.

The role. Valid values:

*   **ADMIN**: workspace administrator. You can add a workspace administrator only as a DMS administrator or a DBA.
*   **MEMBER**: workspace member.
*   **DEVELOPER**: task flow developer. Only a workspace member can be added as a task flow developer.

description.en: The ID of the user to be added. You can call the [ListUsers](~~141938~~) or [GetUser](~~147098~~) operation to obtain the user ID.

description.en:
The ID of the object.

*   If the object is a workspace, you can call the [GetLhSpaceByName](~~424379~~) operation to obtain the workspace ID.
*   If the object is a task flow, you can call the [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to obtain the task flow ID.

title.zh: 添加项目空间管理员、空间成员或任务流开发者
title.en: Add project space administrators, space members, or task stream developers

descriptions.zh:
前提条件：您的用户角色为管理员、DBA或空间管理员。  

补充说明：

- 新增任务流开发者时，请先添加该用户为空间成员。 
- 本接口不支持移交任务流负责人，请调用[ChangLhDagOwner](~~424761~~)接口移交项目空间任务流负责人。
- 关于数仓开发项目空间中的角色划分，请参见[项目空间权限体系](~~410893~~)。
descriptions.en:
Prerequisites: Your user role must be administrator, DBA, or space administrator.  

Additional notes:

- Before adding a task stream developer, you must first add the user as a space member.  
- This API does not support transferring ownership of a task stream. To transfer ownership of a task stream in a project space, invoke the [ChangLhDagOwner](~~424761~~) API.  
- For details about role definitions in a data warehouse development project space, see [Project Space Permission Model](~~410893~~).
